title: Intensive Intermediate Chinese
description: Emphasis placed on acquiring new vocabulary and developing reading skills. Students have the opportunity to make more advanced classroom presentations and present longer written assignments in Chinese.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of PAAS 318, PAAS 210, PAAS 211, CHIN 249, CHIN 249A, CHIN 249B, CHIN 300.
Not open to fluent speakers of Chinese.
